Section 7. Cancellation. Customer may cancel this Agreement at any time
upon thirty (30) days' written notice to Provider. Early termination fees
apply if cancelled within the first twelve (12) months: a fee equal to
three (3) months of the then-current subscription fees.

Section 8. Data return. Upon cancellation, Provider will make Customer
Data available for export for ninety (90) days.

response_text:
The service agreement says the customer may cancel at any time with **30 days’ written notice** to the provider. If the agreement is canceled **within the first 12 months**, an **early termination fee equal to 3 months of the then-current subscription fees** applies.

It also says that after cancellation, the provider will make customer data available for export for **90 days**.
